bonuses.description: When taking damage, has a chance to explode into tin shards — one piece of your armour is destroyed outright, but everything nearby takes a great deal of damage.
When dealing damage, has a chance to hurl a piece of your armour at the enemy. It hits very hard and lands on the ground where it fell.

When taking damage, has a chance to steal durability from the rest of your armour and pour it into whichever piece is worst off. When dealing damage, has a chance to scoop up and re-equip armour lying on the ground.
Verdigris blooms wherever you are struck. 20% of the damage you take is returned to everything within six metres.
Every kill has a chance to mend two points of wear on whichever piece of your armour is in the worst condition.
Bronze is heavy and you have stopped noticing. +60 maximum health.
The alloy drinks what it spills. 8% of the damage you deal returns to you as health.
Bronze endures. Your armour wears out at half the usual rate.
